Silver moonlight tremblings
Wending their way with the wet and winds
Into sinew, solution, stipulation and sense,
Reaching through veils absolute
Made partial pretence.

The sail is high as the storm
Surges and the seas bubble.
Some would say there's trouble out
Here - it's easier to choose doubt than to travel torn.
The cargo is well aware of the tempest,
Yet not forlorn -
It brought the compass, the direction, it set the rout;
Could doubt have trusted that it's sacred earth
We carry east to seed the dawn devout?
